description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SimpleBankingGlobalException' used for global exception handling in the banking application. It includes Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction and extends RuntimeException to create a runtime exception class with additional fields 'code' and 'message'.

classes.name: SimpleBankingGlobalException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class for global exception handling, including error code and message.

methods.name: SimpleBankingGlobalException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, passing it to the superclass RuntimeException.
